correctness.rationale: For a state (N,I,D), a root event at rate 1 sends (N,I,D) to (2N+1,2I-1,D+1); nonroot leaves at rate (N+I)/2 send I to I-1, other nonroot vertices send I to I+1. The generator yields G I=-2, G(I^2)=I^2-6I+N and G(I z^D)=[2(z-1)I-(1+z)]z^D. With E z^D=e^{(z-1)t}, solve the forced ODE from initial (3,1,0); differentiation and the second moment ODE give the stated mixed transform, covariance and exact variance. Independently checked the symbolic generator substitutions, including the boundary at z=1 and e^t coefficients. Moment localization is supported by finite size moments; simulations alone not invoked.
